name: The Cult of the Damned

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know how living cultists laid waste to Lordaeron and brought about your undeath. Stopping new Cult cells in Tirisfal helps secure your new kingdom.
As a priest, you recognize how the Cult of the Damned twists faith. Its members trade sacred devotion for dark necromancy.
As a paladin, you swore to eradicate the shadow that broke Lordaeron. Living cultists devoted to the Scourge are sworn enemies of the Light.

aliases: what is cult of the damned
faq.answer: The Cult of the Damned is made up of mortals who willingly serve the Lich King and the Scourge. These living acolytes spread plague, sabotage defenses, and practice necromancy by choice instead of being raised as mindless undead.
faq.q: What is the Cult of the Damned?

faq.answer: Tirisfal Glades remains contested, haunted by mindless undead, Scarlet Crusade zealots, and surviving Scourge influence. The Cult works in secret to undermine local resistance and advance the Scourge's dark designs.
faq.q: Why are members of the Cult operating in Tirisfal Glades?

faq.answer: Dark Neophytes are new initiates learning dark arts and rituals. Dark Enforcers guard the Cult's operations and enforce discipline. Together, they make up active cells in the region.
faq.q: Who are the Dark Neophytes and Dark Enforcers?

faq.answer: Mindless undead act by instinct or direct command, while living cultists knowingly choose treachery. They can blend into mortal societies and infiltrate settlements, making them more insidious than roaming ghouls or skeletons.
faq.q: Why are living servants considered worse than mindless undead?

faq.answer: Lordaeron fell not only to invasion, but also when the Cult of the Damned poisoned grain and betrayed fellow citizens from within. If cultists gain a foothold, the same catastrophe could follow.
faq.q: What does the quest mean by not letting Lordaeron's history repeat itself?

faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade fanatically hunts anything tainted by undeath, so the Scourge and the Cult are its targets. Their conflict leaves local inhabitants caught between mindless horrors, zealous crusaders, and covert cultists.
faq.q: How does the Cult relate to the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal?

sections.body: The Scourge has living servants who swear fealty to the Lich King. They serve where the mindless dead cannot. In Tirisfal Glades, people already face roaming undead and the relentless zealots of the Scarlet Crusade. Now, newly discovered cells of Dark Neophytes and Dark Enforcers show the Scourge seeking a foothold again.
sections.title: Mortal Agents of the Scourge

sections.body: The marching dead were not the only cause of Lordaeron's fall. Neighbors betrayed neighbors as the Cult of the Damned infiltrated villages and poisoned granaries. From the shadows, they helped bring the kingdom down. Fresh Cult activity in Tirisfal threatens to repeat that history in the scarred lands of the north.
sections.title: Lessons of the Fall

summary: In Tirisfal Glades, living servants of the Scourge threaten the people once more. By culling Dark Neophytes and Dark Enforcers, you help keep the Lich King's agents from repeating the betrayals that shattered Lordaeron.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Cult of the Damned
